moss.dev.title: Moss: semantic search that runs inside your app
moss.dev.markdown:
# Semantic search that runs inside your app

In-process retrieval for agents, apps and devices. Compiled to WASM: runs in the browser, on the edge and offline. No vector database, no network hop.

## Why teams switch

- **Sub-10 ms retrieval** in your own runtime. No round trip per query.
- **Works offline.** Index locally, sync from the cloud when online.
- **Embeddings included.** Send text; we embed it with a built-in model.
- **TypeScript and Python SDKs.**

## Built for voice agents

Voice turns have an 800 ms budget. Retrieval should not take 150 ms of it. Load your index into the agent process and query it in single-digit milliseconds.

## Pricing

Free tier with 3 indexes. Usage pricing after that.
